statement: An increase in recovery location and/or advanced recovery share was detected.
score_semantics: Uncalibrated standardized effect score; not a probability or significance level.

metric_definitions.recovery_count: Distinct recovery/interception/tackle action keys (team, possession, time, actor); not necessarily turnovers.
metric_definitions.high_recovery_count: Recovery actions with team-relative x >=70 metres.
metric_definitions.high_recovery_rate_per_minute: High recovery count * 60 / window exposure seconds.
metric_definitions.high_recovery_share: High recovery count / recovery count; null when count is zero.
metric_definitions.mean_recovery_x_m: Arithmetic mean team-relative recovery x in metres; null without recoveries.
metric_definitions.recovery_x_variance: Sample variance of recovery x (metres squared); null with fewer than two recoveries.
metric_definitions.defensive_episodes: Challenge/tackle/interception grouped per actor/possession/team until a 5-second gap.
metric_definitions.advanced_defensive_episodes: Defensive episodes whose first event has team-relative x >=70 metres.
metric_definitions.final_third_entries: Positive increments in possession counter, counted by possession team at observation time.
metric_definitions.attacking_actions: Pass attempts, receives and dribbles; an event-tempo proxy, not completed passes.
metric_definitions.shots: Shot events, not calibrated xG or goal probability.
metric_definitions.exposure_seconds: Length of the comparison window in cumulative match-clock seconds.

warnings: Synthetic uncalibrated match; observed change does not establish coach intent or causation.
Complete prefix references support counter and episode dependencies; illustrative IDs are only examples.
Final-third counters are observed at event times and may miss unobserved crossings near window edges.
